title: FanCurve
subtitle: A Mac fan curve that follows the hotter of CPU and GPU

steps.title: Read
steps.desc: Every two seconds, read the CPU and GPU sensors from the SMC

steps.title: Pick
steps.desc: Average each group and take the hotter one

steps.title: Set
steps.desc: Map it onto your curve and write the fan target speed

steps.title: Show
steps.desc: The menu bar app shows temperatures and edits the curve
